reviews.comment:
Y este acá de donde salio?? De una peli de
Estados Unidos?

Un lugar rarisimo, de afuera no das dos mangos, hasta pensamos que no tenía cafetería

Después entras y hay un bar re copado y el hotel se veía impecable

Con un montón de ptos para comprar, sala de reuniones y gim!

(Translated by Google)
And where did this place come from? From an American movie?

It's a really strange place; from the outside, you wouldn't think it was anything special. We even thought it didn't have a café.

Then you go inside and there's a really cool bar, and the hotel looked immaculate.

With tons of shops, a meeting room, and a gym!
